sokkel-egui.note: Drawn from the resolved chip paints: tones, hues, both sizes, the faces, the remove button and the keys. Its dash is 3 on 3, and words.remove a string (a function of the words is sokkel-ui's).

sokkel-tui.note: Not in sokkel-tui's reports as of b99664f.

summary: A short value as a chip: a tag on a job, a state that has no run color, a value that is absent. Its tone says how it reads: neutral, a semantic color's wash with its own ink, outline (a hairline edge) or absent (dashed, muted). hue gives it a category's color instead, from the chart palette or a kind color. It may be a button (onSelect, a toggle with selected), a link (href), a menu's trigger (menu), and may end in a remove button (onRemove). No press on it reaches a row or a card around it. A badge says how loud a value is; a chip is a value that can be pressed, chosen, removed or opened.

anatomy.container: The chip: rounded by radius-chip with a 1px edge (transparent but where a tone, hue or selection draws it), on one line, as wide as its words and never wider than its room, the words ending in an ellipsis.
anatomy.face: What the chip says: its icon, then its words, 4 apart, padded across; the press when the chip is a button, a link or a menu's trigger, reaching over the chip's edge so it is as tall as the chip.
anatomy.icon: Before the words, at the chip's icon size; an icon given its own size keeps it.
anatomy.chevron: After the words of a menu's trigger, at 70 percent.
anatomy.externalMark: After the words of an external link, an arrow up and right at 70 percent, with words for a screen reader saying it opens in a new tab.
anatomy.remove: A button at the chip's end, its own stop in the tab order: an X, padded 2 and 2 in from the chip's end, rounded by radius-mini, at 70 percent until hovered.

tone.does: How it reads: neutral on a faint wash; good, critical, warning and info on their color's wash at 15 percent with its ink; outline only edged; absent, dashed in border-strong around muted words, for a value that is not there.

hue.does: A category's color, worn in place of the tone, for chips that tell kinds apart: one of the chart palette's five, set by a theme with the charts', or a kind color, the same paints as a badge's kind. Its wash at 12 percent, its edge at 30, its ink.

size.does: default sits in a line of text or a table cell; control stands alone as a control does, as tall as a field or a button, and a finger tall below md.

mono.does: The words in the code face, for an id, a tag or a key.

title.does: Said on hover: the whole value when the chip cuts it short, or what it means.

onSelect.does: Makes the face a button. Its press stops at the chip.

selectLabel.does: The button's or the link's name and tooltip, when a press does more than the words say ("Filter by harbor"); the words by default.

selected.does: With onSelect, a toggle: the button says it is pressed, and the chip wears an edge in its own ink over a stronger wash.

menu.does: Makes the face a menu's trigger, with a chevron after the words; a press opens the items (label, icon, onSelect, disabled, destructive) in parts/dropdown-menu's menu under the chip. It takes the place of onSelect and href.

menuAlign.does: Where the menu lines up under the chip.

href.does: Makes the face a link to what the chip names, through the app's link provider. It takes the place of onSelect.

external.does: Opens href in a new tab, safely, with the external mark after the words.

open.does: The menu open, held by the app; left out, the chip holds it (defaultOpen, onOpenChange).

onRemove.does: Ends the chip in a remove button, named by words.remove. Its press stops at the chip.

default.note: padX is the face's; with a remove button the face keeps only its start pad.

remove.note: 2 in from the chip's end on each side (mx 2).

hover.means: The pointer is over a pressable face (its words underlined) or the remove button (washed, at full strength).

focus.means: Keyboard focus on the face or the remove button: the focus outline, 1 out.

selected.means: A toggle chip turned on: pressed, edged in its own ink over a stronger wash.

keyboard.does: Reaches the face when it is a button, a link or a menu's trigger, then the remove button; a plain chip takes no focus.
Presses the face (selects, toggles, follows the link or opens the menu) without pressing a row or a card around the chip.
Removes the chip, without pressing a row or a card around it.
Opens the menu, as parts/dropdown-menu's trigger does.
keyboard.when: the face is a menu's trigger

appText.selectLabel: What a press does, when the words do not say it.

sokkel-ui: words.remove may be a function of the chip's words ("Remove harbor").
Any other attribute of a span and ref go to the root, so a chip can be a tooltip or popover trigger's render target.
The menu is parts/dropdown-menu (Base UI's), loaded when first opened.

drift.today: As of b99664f its reports name no such part.
